description.hi: श्रीपञ्चमुखहनुमत्कवचम् — विनियोग, ध्यान, पञ्चमुख-मन्त्र, न्यास, फलश्रुति।
description.en: Panchmukha Hanumat Kavacam — viniyoga, dhyana, five-face mantras, nyasa, phalashruti.

edition.notes: Corrected 2026-07-23: replaced wrong-bija pseudo-kavach with traditional structure (ह्रीं/श्रीं/क्रौं seeds, five-face mantras, phala).
